criteria.requirement: Nationals of an African Union member state; the AU member-states page lists the Democratic Republic of Congo.
criteria.applicant: Citizen of the Democratic Republic of the Congo.

criteria.requirement: Final-year Bachelor's student, or holder of a Bachelor's or Master's qualification in a related academic field; the FAQ says graduates may apply.
criteria.applicant: Bachelor's degree (Licence) in Business Administration, obtained in 2024.
criteria.quote: graduates of Bachelor’s degree, Master’s degree and PhD

criteria.requirement: The degree must be in a field related to the host department and the terms of reference of the position.
criteria.missing: The terms of reference of the department the AU would assign; the posting names no required field of study.
criteria.quote: Must have obtained a Bachelor’s degree or an advanced/ post graduate (Masters) qualification in a related academic field;

criteria.requirement: Aged between 22 and 32 at the time of application (programme page); no more than 32 at the time of selection (posting).
criteria.missing: Exact age: the programme page sets a lower limit of 22 and the profile records only the band under 30.
criteria.quote: Applicants must be aged between 22 and 32 at the time of application;

criteria.requirement: Fluent in at least one AU working language (Arabic, English, French or Portuguese).
criteria.applicant: French and English are among the recorded languages.
criteria.quote: Be fluent in at least one of the African Union working languages (Arabic, English, French or Portuguese).

criteria.applicant: Under one year of internships and field assignments, no full-time employment.
criteria.quote: Prior work experience is not required for the internship positions.

criteria.requirement: A copy of a valid passport or national identity card with the application.
criteria.missing: Whether the applicant holds a valid passport (the page also accepts a national identity card, but travel to Ethiopia needs a passport).
criteria.quote: A copy of valid passport or national identity card

criteria.requirement: Recommendation letter for internship from the institution of learning the applicant is attending.
criteria.applicant: Not recorded as enrolled in any degree programme.
criteria.missing: Whether the AU accepts a recommendation letter from the institution of the 2024 degree for a graduate who is no longer attending.
criteria.quote: Recommendation letter for internship from the institution of learning that they are attending

funding.conditions: Travel to and from the internship location is the intern's.
funding.quote: Interns will not be entitled to any compensation for travel.

funding.conditions: Cost of accommodation is the intern's responsibility.
funding.quote: The AU will have no financial obligation towards interns - travel arrangements and cost of accommodation and living expenses will be the responsibility of the interns.

funding.conditions: Living expenses are the intern's responsibility.
funding.quote: The AU will have no financial obligation towards interns - travel arrangements and cost of accommodation and living expenses will be the responsibility of the interns.
AU does not provide any financial support or cover any costs for living expenses during the assignment for interns.

funding.conditions: Interns must hold individual insurance and are not entitled to medical evacuation at the Commission's expense.
funding.quote: Interns shall therefore have an individual insurance coverage throughout the duration of the internship.

funding.conditions: The AU says it will use reasonable efforts to assist with entry and residence visas; fees are not stated.

out_of_pocket: Unknown amount: flights, accommodation, living costs, insurance and visa are all the intern's; the pages state no figures.
